title: The fake L9 incident document
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: there was actually a fake >> document created called the L9 incident at Ellsworth Air Force Base, which was a day before Michael and Mario's experience

plain: Michels says a fake document was made up describing an "L9 incident" at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, set one day before an encounter that two men named Michael and Mario say they had there. Michels tells this himself in 1977's context, citing a man named Richard Doty in connection with the document. The point is that a planted false record could muddy what the two men say they really saw.
